name: Supertato
description: Follow the adventures of Supertato, the world’s first potato superhero, as he tackles the mischievous Evil Pea in the supermarket aisles.

videos.title: Supertato Song
videos.overview: It’s Supertato to the rescue! Sing along to some of Supertato’s best bits as he saves his veggie friends from Evil Pea. Go, go, go, Supertato!

videos.title: Evil Pea (It’s So Good to be Bad) Song
videos.overview: She’s small, green and very mean. Evil Pea keeps sneaking out of the freezer to create chaos – why? Watch and sing along to find out why It's So Good To Be Bad!

videos.title: Supertato Dance Off
videos.overview: It’s a dance off between Evil Pea and Supertato. They show their best moves on the dance floor and each dance up a storm! The veggies watch and cheer for Supertato. Let’s go Supertato!

videos.title: Halloween Song
videos.overview: It’s spooky season in the supermarket, and Supertato is terrified of pumpkins! Sing along with Evil Pea and listen out for when the pumpkin says BOO!

videos.title: Merry Veggie Christmas Song
videos.overview: Meet Sprouty Claus! Ready to bring holiday cheer to the Supermarket. Join Supertato and Friends and sing-a-long. Featuring Greg James.

videos.title: Catchphrase Remix
videos.overview: Muddy Spuds! Potato Power! It’s time for a Supertato and friends Remix everyone! Join your Fruit and Veggie Friends and let’s see those dance moves.

videos.title: Every Day is Super
videos.overview: Every day is Super with our favourite Supertato and Friends! Let’s get these Fruits and Veggies excited for another day in the Supermarket. Grab a friend and make your day an adventure!

videos.title: Cha Cha Chilli
videos.overview: So Spicy! Chilli takes the Cha Cha to a new level, making the whole Supermarket want to dance. Come on and Cha Cha Chilli with Supertato and Friends!

videos.title: The Monstertato Song
videos.overview: Get your spooky veggie vibe on with this frightfully delightful Halloween track!

videos.title: It's Christmas Time!
videos.overview: Evil Pea is up to her usual mischief as she turns the Supermarket into a Winter Wonderland!

videos.title: The Supertato Sports Song feat. Runner Bean
videos.overview: Get ready…set…dance in the supermarket aisles with Supertato, Runner Bean and the whole Tato Team. Featuring Nitro from Gladiators.

videos.title: Tato Tower Takeover
videos.overview: Evil Pea takes over the Tato Tower HQ and uses Carrot’s new security system to keep Supertato out. Supertato and Carrot work on a cunning ice cream plan to sneak back in.

videos.title: Evil Pea's Big Freeze
videos.overview: Evil Pea freezes the Veggies so she can take over the whole supermarket. Chilli’s heat unfreezes Supertato, who then races on lolly-stick skis to thwart Evil Pea and save the day.

videos.title: Cheese Moon
videos.overview: It’s a space race as Supertato helps Carrot fly her baguette rocket to become the first Veggie on the cheese moon, but halfway there Evil Pea makes them crash land.

videos.title: Treasure in the Plant Aisle
videos.overview: In the perilous plant aisle, Supertato and Evil Pea team up to find treasure as they have half a map each, but she tricks him and steals the map to find the treasure for herself.

videos.title: Operation Jewel
videos.overview: Evil Pea steals Tomato’s precious jewel. Supertato ventures to get it back by secretly lifting the jewel from Evil Pea’s crown and defeating a crowd of rampaging Mini Peas.

videos.title: The Baddie Belt
videos.overview: Evil Pea swaps Supertato's Tato-Belt with her evil Baddie-Belt, which has absurd and baffling functions. Supertato has to work out how to rescue Carrot and Pea with the Baddie-Belt.

videos.title: Chilli to the Rescue
videos.overview: Chilli decides to become a superhero called Super Chilli! His superhero skills are put to the test when Evil Pea covers Supertato in sticky honey, but Chilli’s heat saves the day.

videos.title: Turnip of Terror
videos.overview: Evil Pea tricks Supertato and the Veggies, who fall into the deli counter and come face to face with the Turnip of Terror. They escape with help from the not-so-scary Turnip.

videos.title: Veggies Gotta Dance
videos.overview: Supertato’s dancing is too powerful and destructive, but when he has to face Evil Pea in a dance-off to save his trapped friends, he soon realises his moves can save the day.

videos.title: Banana's Star Appeal
videos.overview: Banana Superstar’s show is stopped when Evil Pea steals his peel. Supertato races against him to get it back, but trouble hits when a giant banana statue collapses onto the stage.

videos.title: Spooky Day
videos.overview: Supertato runs in fright when Pumpkin tries to make friends with him, but he later realises she needs his help as she’s stuck in the air hanging from balloons set up by Evil Pea.

videos.title: Pea's Power Suit
videos.overview: Evil Pea wears a giant powersuit so powerful it knocks Supertato across the supermarket aisles. Carrot and Supertato plan to outsmart Evil Pea so she’ll lose her new powers.

videos.title: Double Doughnut Rescue
videos.overview: Evil Pea plunges Broccoli and Carrot into the doughnut toppings simultaneously, and Supertato almost quits being a superhero when he can’t save his two friends at the same time.

videos.title: Evil Pea Takes a Break
videos.overview: The Cobs try to capture Supertato while Evil Pea is on holiday, but it goes wrong resulting in Evil Pea getting covered in flour and custard over in the bath products aisle.

videos.title: Super Birthday
videos.overview: Supertato is delighted when Evil Pea comes to his birthday party, but Carrot is suspicious. Soon Evil Pea unleashes the Mini Peas, who try to steal Supertato’s birthday present.

videos.title: Winter Wonderland
videos.overview: Evil Pea thinks the Veggies won’t like it when she covers the supermarket in ice, but instead they have the best snow day ever, so she creates a giant snowball to ruin their fun.

videos.title: The Good, the Bad and the Prickly
Wishing Tree
videos.overview: Evil Pea blows all the lanterns away during the Lantern Festival. Supertato struggles to get them all back and needs Broccoli’s help to save the day.

videos.title: Grape Kids' Super Camp
videos.overview: Supertato leads the Grape Kids at Super Camp, but Evil Pea takes over with her Ice Camp.

videos.title: Operation Kiwi
videos.overview: Supertato, Carrot and Tomato are exploring in the plant aisle when they hear a strange noise. They follow the noise and meet the famous Kiwi the Explorer, who needs their help.

videos.title: Museum Mischief
videos.overview: Evil Pea pretends to help Supertato and Carrot train for crime prevention, but she tricks them and steals a mobile phone. Supertato and Carrot have a clever plan to get it back.

videos.title: Broccoli Flies Again
videos.overview: Evil Pea asks for flying lessons when Broccoli flies her paper plane into her freezer. Evil Pea doesn’t let Broccoli know that she intends to fly high to take over Tato Tower.

videos.title: Tin Can Games
videos.overview: It’s the Tin Can Games and Evil Pea wants to win the Tin Can Trophy. She cheats in the final race by putting a magnet on Supertato’s back to stop him from going super fast.

videos.title: Tablet Takeover
videos.overview: The Veggies are delighted with a new tablet they’ve found. When they’re not looking, Evil Pea turns the tablet to evil mode. Soon the tablet takes over the supermarket.

videos.title: Carrot's Big Top
videos.overview: Carrot is starring in her own circus and thinks that Supertato is trying to steal her limelight. She soon realises that Supertato is trying to rescue her from Evil Pea’s meddling.

videos.title: Undercover Tomato
videos.overview: Tomato paints himself green and goes undercover as a Mini Pea to discover how Evil Pea is firing them at Tato Tower. He makes an unexpected new Mini Pea friend.

videos.title: Toy Aisle Trouble
videos.overview: Evil Pea takes all the toys in the supermarket for herself and the Cobs to play with. Supertato climbs a big wall of boxes to try and get the toys back.

videos.title: Peas and Quiet
videos.overview: There are odd noises in the supermarket. Supertato discovers that Evil Pea and the Mini Peas are asleep and walking through the supermarket. Supertato tries to get them back to bed.

videos.title: Cereal Mountain
videos.overview: Chilli tries to reach the top of Cereal Mountain without the help of Supertato’s gadgets.

videos.title: Dragon Boat Beats
videos.overview: Supertato and Evil Pea race one another in the Dragon Boat Race Festival on Ice. Evil Pea’s team seem to be the fastest, until Supertato helps his team to row in harmony.

videos.title: How to Be a Supertato
videos.overview: In Tato Tower, Supertato shows the Grape Kids a film on how to be a Supertato like him.

videos.title: The Throne Thief
videos.overview: Someone has stolen Evil Pea’s throne, and all clues point to Supertato as the thief!

videos.title: Broccoli Alone
videos.overview: Supertato is out chasing a milkshake robot and leaves Broccoli in charge of Tato Tower. Evil Pea tries to take over the tower, but Broccoli puts on a great defence.

videos.title: Pea Repeats
videos.overview: Supertato is due to receive the Best Hero Award, but Evil Pea decides she should get it. Carrot tells her she needs to defeat herself to win the award.

videos.title: Da Veggie Code
videos.overview: Supertato’s Tato belt gets locked inside a glass case for an exhibition, but Tomato can’t remember the code to get it out again, and Supertato needs it back to defeat Evil Pea.

videos.title: Double Trouble
videos.overview: Supertato and Carrot are looking for ice and think Evil Pea has become kind by giving them some. They soon realize it’s not Evil Pea after all.

videos.title: Carrot Powers Up
videos.overview: Carrot wants to become superstrong, so she restores Evil Pea’s robot suit for herself.

videos.title: Evil Pea’s Veggie Vision
videos.overview: Evil Pea is tricked by lots of Supertatoes who appear all over the supermarket.

videos.title: Come Back Cobs
videos.overview: The Cobs have finally had enough of Evil Pea’s ungratefulness and team up with Supertato.

videos.title: Big Net Rescue
videos.overview: Carrot is determined to save Supertato from Evil Pea’s trap without help from Prickly Pear.

videos.title: Moustache Mystery
videos.overview: Broccoli is horrified when someone paints moustaches on photographs of her friends!

videos.title: Waltzing Potato
videos.overview: Evil Pea plans to freeze Supertato into an ice cube by pretending to teach him to dance.

videos.title: Broccoli’s Movie Night
videos.overview: It’s movie night, and Broccoli is showing her movie called Supertato: The Movie. But Evil Pea keeps changing the story to make herself look like the hero instead of Supertato.

videos.title: The Tato Team
videos.overview: During the Veggies' Super Sidekick Costume Contest, Evil Pea traps Supertato in a jar of honey. All is lost until the Veggies become real super sidekicks, the Tato Team!

videos.title: Speedy Pea
videos.overview: Evil Pea steals Supertato's brand new Tato Car but doesn't realise that the Grape Kids are in the back seat. Supertato has to get the Grape Kids back to safety and save his car.

videos.title: Ahoy Captain Pak Choi
videos.overview: Supertato and Broccoli go on a pirate adventure with Captain Pak Choi, but they don't realize she intends on plundering Evil Pea's freezer and stealing all her shiny things.

videos.title: Veg-O-Vision Song Contest
videos.overview: Supertato and the Tato Team must battle to save Tato Tower from Evil Pea's earth-shaking stomping performance at the Veg-O-Vision Song Contest.

videos.title: Desserts of Destiny
videos.overview: Evil Pea lures Supertato and Tomato into her cave of frosted doom. Can they find the courage to avoid her traps and retrieve The Lost Candle of Birthdays for Tomato’s Museum?

videos.title: Tato Tower Sleepover
videos.overview: Supertato invites Evil Pea to his sleepover, but Carrot is suspicious and vows to stay up all night to make sure she can't unleash any of her evil plans.

videos.title: Trolley Dash
videos.overview: Evil Pea causes chaos in the veggie aisle with a trolley loaded to the brim with stinky cheese. Supertato and Broccoli must use the Tato Car to get rid of the stink.

videos.title: A Clean Getaway
videos.overview: Supertato and Tomato find themselves stuck in a slippery bathtub, whilst Evil Pea rampages around the supermarket on a giant soap-squirting machine.

videos.title: Super Sandcastle
videos.overview: Supertato and the Veggies have built a super sandcastle, but Evil Pea wants to storm it by firing her hordes of Mini Peas at it with her pea shooter.

videos.title: Walkie-Talkie
videos.overview: The veggies are playing walkie-talkie hide-and-seek, but Evil Pea steals Carrot’s walkie-talkie and uses it to trick the Veggies into getting trapped by the Corn Cobs.

videos.title: Evil Pea's Party Plan
videos.overview: It’s Evil Pea’s birthday, but she and Carrot are trapped in the bottom of her freezer. They must put their differences aside and work together to escape.

videos.title: Sweetieland Saga
videos.overview: Evil Pea cheats Chilli out of winning floofy teddies at a funfair made from sweets, so Supertato and the Veggies must get the teddies back before it’s too late!

videos.title: Monstertato
videos.overview: Evil Pea creates an evil version of her nemesis, Supertato. With the help of her laboratory and her hench-Cobs, Evil Pea makes a big, green lumbering spud that she names Monstertato!

videos.title: Merry Sprouty Day (1)
videos.overview: It’s Merry Sprouty Day, and everyone is waiting for Sprouty Claus, who is bringing presents to all the good fruit and veggies. However, Evil Pea has an evil plan - to steal the presents for herself!

videos.title: Merry Sprouty Day (2)
videos.overview: It's Merry Sprouty Day, but Evil Pea jumps onto Sprouty Claus's train and steals all the presents for herself!

videos.title: Robotato
videos.overview: Evil Pea has trapped Supertato and replaced him with an evil robot potato, programmed to do mean things and ruin his reputation. Will Carrot figure it out in time?

videos.title: Three Peas in a Pod
videos.overview: Supertato and the Tato Team face a trio of Evil Peas when Mummy Pea and Daddy Pea come to visit Evil Pea. They vow to help her take over the supermarket once and for all.

videos.title: Teething Problems
videos.overview: Evil Pea is annoyed by Supertato's winning smile, so she takes all the toothpaste in the supermarket to make sure it disappears forever.

videos.title: Tatocar Takeover
videos.overview: Evil Pea uses a remote control to drive the Tato Team to the far side of the supermarket. Can they return and save the fruit and veggie aisle?

videos.title: The Amazing Jalapeño
videos.overview: Chilli is excited to see Jalapeno attempt a tart-jumping record. But when Evil Pea ruins the attempt in order to steal the record, Supertato and Captain Chilli must save the day!

videos.title: Robotato Returns
videos.overview: Evil Pea commands Carrot's new and improved Robotato to protect her. But when he malfunctions and carries her to the top of Tato Tower, it's up to the real Supertato to save her.

videos.title: Fruit and Veggie Friends Day
videos.overview: Everyone in the supermarket is enjoying Fruit and Veggie Friends Day, where they get to celebrate friendship, but Evil Pea wants to ruin it - and Supertato keeps stopping her.

videos.title: Kite Plight
videos.overview: Evil Pea uses her balloon to cut down everyone's kites so she can rule the supermarket skies. Supertato and Carrot must use chopsticks to stop her.

videos.title: Crafty Pea
videos.overview: Evil Pea makes a monster costume in the craft aisle to scare the Tato Team out of the supermarket, but Supertato wants to be the monster’s friend.

videos.title: Argh! Jelly!
videos.overview: Broccoli shows Supertato her latest art exhibition of jelly sculptures, but jelly is Supertato’s secret fear. When Evil Pea finds out, she comes up with an evil idea to beat him.

videos.title: Veggie Magic
videos.overview: When Evil Pea poses as a magician so that she can use tricks to make the Tato Team 'disappear', Supertato and Carrot create their own magical plan to rescue them.

videos.title: Young Veggies: Part 1
videos.overview: It's Harvest Festival in the supermarket, and Supertato tells the Grape Kids, Tomato, Broccoli and Chilli the story of his first Harvest Festival - the day he arrived in the supermarket! But Evil Pea hijacks the story, explaining how she arrived on the same day, and how she and Supertato first met. She reveals a shocking truth - young Supertato helped her freeze all the fruits and veggies in the supermarket! Supertato admits this is true, but there is more to the story.

videos.title: Young Veggies: Part 2
videos.overview: In Part 2, Supertato tells his side of the story. Yes, he did freeze everyone - but with Carrot's help, he realises that Evil Pea had tricked him, and he vows to make it right. Carrot helps Supertato master his powers - except his speed, which he still can’t control - and in his superhero costume, he’s ready to face Evil Pea. But she freezes him into a block of ice! He can’t break free until Carrot encourages him to use his potato speed. Soon, he bursts out of the ice block and speeds around melting the rest of the ice! It’s the first time Supertato saves the supermarket.

videos.title: Freezy Sprinklers
videos.overview: The Veggies are in the middle of working out when Evil Pea interrupts to tell them about her plan to freeze the entire supermarket. She has placed freezy sprinklers all around the aisles! They split up to deactivate the sprinklers before it's too late. But when the Veggies reach them, they realise the sprinklers are fake. Evil Pea is actually getting on with her real, even bigger plan - setting up a giant freezy hose to freeze Tato Tower! The Veggies must now get to Tato Tower in time for Supertato to save the day.

videos.title: Melon Melon
videos.overview: Evil Pea befriends the playful but destructive Baby Watermelon to try and destroy Tato Tower. Her plan backfires when Baby Watermelon only wants to play with Evil Pea, and things get worse when she gets cranky because she's tired. The Veggies get Baby Watermelon into her crate for a nap by making Evil Pea sing her a lullaby. Evil Pea takes this opportunity to eject Supertato from the Tatocar and into the watermelon's crate! Fortunately, Supertato befriends Baby Watermelon's daddy, who scares Evil Pea back to the freezer.

videos.title: Runner Bean
videos.overview: Supertato and his running rival, Runner Bean, are about to compete in the yearly supermarket race. But this year, Evil Pea plans to cheat her way to victory - she wants to see Supertato's face when she finally beats him. The race begins, and Evil Pea unleashes several traps with the help of the Cobs. Supertato and Runner Bean are trapped upside down. Evil Pea almost wins but realises Supertato won’t see her beat him. She releases them and races towards the finish, but Supertato launches Runner Bean like a javelin and sprints to the finish line so that they can win together!

videos.title: The Evil Peamobile
videos.overview: Evil Pea makes her own Evil Peamobile. It's just like the Tatocar, but she's upgraded it with even better gadgets. Supertato and Carrot try to stop her in the Tatocar, but Evil Pea ices the floor and gets away using the Evil Peamobile's skis. It’s Carrot's job to add more gadgets to the Tatocar. They head out on their brand new skis - but Evil Pea starts shooting snowballs from her Peamobile and corners the Tatocar! Luckily, Carrot has another new gadget ready. The Tatocar turns into the Tatocopter and dodges the snowballs, which causes them to fall back on Evil Pea.

videos.title: Trolley Cruise
videos.overview: Supertato, Carrot and Broccoli win tickets for a luxurious trolley cruise - despite not even entering a competition. It turns out to be a trick by Evil Pea, who has disguised herself as the captain and rigged the trolley to go full speed out of the exit! She breaks the handle off the fan and evacuates the trolley. When it looks like the Tato Team are doomed, Carrot comes up with a plan. They hook exercise bands on the end of the aisles, and Supertato uses all his strength to bring the trolley to a stop just before they reach the exit doors!

videos.title: Couch Potato
videos.overview: Evil Pea launches Supertato down the back of a sofa, but her plan goes wrong when she falls in too. Stuck inside with no obvious way out, they meet kooky Raisin, who lives down there with her collection of buttons. Raisin shows them the only way out of the sofa – a thread hanging from above. But Evil Pea climbs up first and undoes the thread, leaving Supertato trapped. Inspired by Raisin and her buttons, Supertato uses them, along with the thread, to create a pulley system to get out.

videos.title: The Golden Snuggybear
videos.overview: Supertato helps Tomato get a rare Golden Snuggybear for his museum from a giant toy capsule vending machine, but Evil Pea traps them inside by freezing the machine and takes the toy for herself! Supertato tries to break free but fails. Determined to escape, Tomato transforms into the Red Roller, whirls around the inside of the machine, breaks the ice and sets them free. Supertato and Tomato surf the resulting wave of toy balls to catch up with Evil Pea and rescue the Golden Snuggybear.

videos.title: Poor Little Pea
videos.overview: The Tato Team are having a day off, so Carrot upgrades the Tatoscope to alert Supertato to any of Evil Pea’s plans - and it works straight away! Pea pretends she's hurt her foot so Supertato will invite her into Tato Tower to recover. However, Supertato is so attentive that he doesn't leave her alone. Eventually, Pea shakes him off long enough to try and break the Tatoscope. But it goes into defence mode, and she ends up clinging off it like a bucking bronco. It’s Supertato to the rescue, but he realises she’s been faking it this whole time.

videos.title: Captain Pak Choi Returns
videos.overview: Supertato and Carrot are following a treasure map to Shiny Things Island - even though the map was suspiciously left outside Tato Tower for Supertato to find. It’s one of Evil Pea’s tricks! But Captain Pak Choi is also on the island and takes the map to find the treasure first. Along the way, they spring a variety of Evil Pea’s traps. When Evil Pea manages to catch Supertato and Carrot, Captain Pak Choi frees them and sends Evil Pea flying for deceiving her with fake treasure!

videos.title: Evil Peamobile Goes Rogue
videos.overview: Evil Pea adds a voice control feature to her Evil Peamobile - she wants to command it to freeze all the fruit and veggies in the supermarket. But the vehicle turns on her when she shouts at it for not obeying her commands quick enough. Suddenly, Evil Pea is being chased by her own car and needs the help of Supertato and Tomato, who teach her that a little 'please' and 'thank you' can go a long way - even with an Evil Peamobile.

videos.title: Frantic Football
videos.overview: Carrot, Broccoli and Chilli’s team have just won the Supermarket Cup. Supertato is about to give them the Golden Ball trophy when Evil Pea challenges them to a winner-takes-all game - she plans to wear her 'cheaty boots' that make her unstoppable at football. But she turns the boots up to the highest setting, which sends them haywire and cause her to score own goals - and even kick the giant golden ball off the trophy. Luckily, Supertato and the Tato Team are there to save the day, and they still win the match!

videos.title: The Dough Blob
videos.overview: Evil Pea makes a giant dough blob to completely cover the supermarket. But when it continues to rise and doesn’t follow any of her commands, she realises she’s made a mistake. Supertato uses some baking know-how to knead the dough back, but this makes it even bigger. Just as it is about to take over, Carrot uses the Evil Peamobile's ice blaster to freeze the dough and stop it in its tracks.

videos.title: Dangle Disaster
videos.overview: Evil Pea has set a trap for the Tatocar but accidentally gets herself and Corn trapped inside the Evil Peamobile. Her escape attempts only make the situation worse, and when Supertato offers help, she sets off the Evil Peamobile’s ice blaster. The trap is now very close to breaking. Supertato tells Evil Pea not to move a muscle, which sends her into a rage that makes the trap break and the car to plummet towards the ground - but Supertato saves the day!

videos.title: Supertato's Holiday
videos.overview: Supertato is on holiday in the beach aisle but can’t relax with Evil Pea out there. Carrot sets up defences to stop her breaking into Tato Tower, but Evil Pea has a universal remote that can turn off Carrot’s inventions. Evil Pea runs into Tato Tower, only to find it empty. They’ve all left the supermarket - she’s finally won! But Evil Pea soon realises that ruling the supermarket isn’t as much fun as she thought it’d be without Supertato to stop her.

videos.title: Disco Fog
videos.overview: The Tato Team are having a disco, but Evil Pea ruins their fun by turning the fog machine up to maximum so that they all get lost. Broccoli tries to stop her, but the machine malfunctions and quickly fills the supermarket with thick fog. Supertato and Carrot try to save everyone by using their jetpacks, but they can’t see them. When Broccoli hears the duo flying above, she uses her new dance move, the broccoli fling, and sends Evil Pea flying up out of the fog.

videos.title: Pirate Ship Pursuit
videos.overview: Captain Pak Choi visits Tato Tower for the 'free shiny things' advertised on a sign outside, but it’s a trick by Evil Pea to take her pirate ship. Captain Pak Choi teams up with Supertato and jumps in the Tatocar to retrieve her ship, but the Corn Cobs throw barrels to get them off course. Supertato uses the ejector seat and fires his plunger onto the back of the ship so Captain Pak Choi can climb aboard. However, Evil Pea and Captain Pak Choi get tangled up in the ship’s ropes. It’s down to Supertato to raise the sails and stop the ship.

videos.title: The Prickly Pear Kid
videos.overview: It's movie night, and Supertato is thrilled to discover that the star is Prickly Pear - his special skill is rounding up Mini Peas with his pea-yodelling. But the film gives Evil Pea the idea to take over Tato Tower with Mini Peas, trapping Supertato inside. When Supertato is accidentally ejected out of Tato Tower, he must convince Prickly Pear to take up pea-yodelling again so they can both wrangle the Mini Peas back to the freezer.

videos.title: Keep Your Cool
videos.overview: Evil Pea has made herself a new and improved Splatterpult, but Supertato turns up, which makes her lose her temper and accidentally fire herself back to her freezer. Evil Pea is about to quit being evil, until her evil parents pay a visit. Mummy and Daddy Pea teach their daughter how to be cool, calm and evil, so she can beat Supertato. After her training is complete, Evil Pea fires snowballs at Supertato and hits him - she’s overjoyed! But when he brings her snowballs back, all three peas lose their tempers.

videos.title: Corn's Mutiny
videos.overview: Corn is sick and tired of Evil Pea’s plans failing because she’s always boasting about them. When Evil Pea accidentally gets stuck in a block of ice, Corn takes the opportunity to take over and become Evil Corn. After confronting Supertato, Corn plans to cover the supermarket in butter. Evil Pea and Supertato work together to stop her, and Evil Pea knows what Corn’s weakness will be – boasting! At the top of Cereal Mountain, Supertato gets Corn to boast about her evil plan, while Evil Pea butters Corn to the side of the mountain.

videos.title: Home Swap
videos.overview: After Supertato accidentally knocks the ice off Evil Pea’s freezer, she seizes the opportunity to stay at Tato Tower. Supertato is excited to have Evil Pea over, but once inside, she uses her Freezy Hose to freeze Supertato out of his home. Luckily, Carrot has a plan. He goes to Evil Pea's freezer and turns it into Supertato’s freezer. Evil Pea is furious and leaves Tato Tower to tell him to get out, leaving it unguarded. It’s a race to reach the freezer first.

videos.title: Galactic Space Slowdown
videos.overview: Supertato and Chilli are playing a computer game called Dino Defenders 2: Galactic Space Showdown. But just as they are about to win, Evil Pea snatches it away. They try to get it back, but she jumps into a toy version of the Big Bad Spaceship from the game and shoots energy balls at them, turning the supermarket shelves into a real version of the game! Despite their best efforts, they just can’t get past the energy balls. However, Supertato has an idea to use a toy version of a Dino Defender to climb the shelves and beat Evil Pea in the Big Bad Spaceship!

videos.title: To Catch a Button
videos.overview: Raisin is planning on having a Button Exhibition and asks Supertato to look after her most precious button, Princess Bella Bob - and she has put a confetti surprise in its box for the grand opening! But Evil Pea plans to take the button to ruin Supertato’s reputation. After Supertato manages to foil her first two attempts to take Princess Bella Bob, Evil Pea tricks him by impersonating Raisin so she can take the precious button. But when Evil Pea opens the box from a high-up beam in the sofa, the confetti surprise goes off, sending her back to her freezer.

videos.title: The Big Supermarket Game Show
videos.overview: It’s Banana's Big Supermarket Game Show, and Supertato is going head-to-head with Evil Pea to try and win a speedboat. But after failing in the first round, Evil Pea decides to get the Cobs to help her cheat. On the second round, they must identify a mystery fruit or veggie. Supertato guesses correctly, but the Cobs secretly change the clip so that his answer is wrong and Evil Pea gets it right. But Supertato spots the Cobs sabotaging the show, and when Evil Pea thinks she’s won the speedboat, she can’t get away because Supertato is holding it above his head!

videos.title: Fortune Cookies
videos.overview: Evil Pea has made fake fortune cookies for Supertato, Broccoli and Carrot to open. She's going to make them all come true so that she can convince them to leave the supermarket and lock them out!  Each fortune in the cookies immediately comes true. Carrot, however, is very suspicious of them. The final cookie says a great surprise awaits them outside the supermarket, and Evil Pea appears with the universal remote and locks them outdoors! Luckily, Carrot has a plan to make some fortune cookies of her own that will get Evil Pea to reopen the doors.
